title: Fund The Restaurants
tagline: An dapp that allow customers to donate funds to restaurants
description: This project helps restaurants get funds to cover their rent and business expense. Restaurant owners can create a post to get funds from someone.  When creating a post, owner provides information about their restaurant and why they need the funds.  Customers can donate ETH to restaurants owners.
how_its_made: I did the design of the dapp using figma.  Then I build out the front end using react and bootstrap.  I created smart contract using solidity that will store the restaurants data and allow customers to transfer ETH.  I try to integrate Aave for loaning, but I was not able to get it to work.
